title: Check whether the generation pipeline's alpha step leaves near-white behind
tier_reason: Investigation plus a pipeline fix in repo code; worst case is a bad transparency threshold, caught by regenerating and revertable.
ask: Find out if the generation pipeline's alpha step is leaving that white behind, and if so fix it there so nobody hand-erases backdrop pixels.
first_action: Run the Retro Diffusion post-processing alpha step on a known sample generation and inspect the output for opaque near-white pixels where the backdrop should be transparent.
source_message:
> HQ's sprite editor only showed him a quarter of each sheet. 

Why aren't you also creating a story to fix this?
